title: CNET automated financial journalism inaccuracies
system_purpose: Draft explanatory personal finance articles and guides automatically
decision_impact: Published articles directly advised readers on compounding interest and loan savings
verified_facts: CNET published 77 AI-generated articles and subsequent internal audit forced substantive corrections on 41 articles.
reported_harm: Dissemination of incorrect financial advice and loss of journalistic trust
quantitative_evidence: 41 out of 77 articles required corrections (53 percent error rate across published corpus).
limitations: Audit was performed retroactively after external researchers pointed out arithmetic errors; full internal prompts were not published.

title: New York Times v OpenAI copyright regurgitation
system_purpose: Generate synthetic text completions and synthesis based on large training corpus
decision_impact: Model outputs reproduced paywalled journalistic investigations verbatim to end users
verified_facts: Complaint documented multiple instances where prompts caused the model to reproduce verbatim paragraphs of paywalled articles.
reported_harm: Loss of subscription revenue and commercial misappropriation of copyrighted content
quantitative_evidence: Complaint documented 100 verbatim excerpt comparisons across investigative series.
limitations: Lawsuit represents plaintiff allegations in litigation; defendant argued synthetic outputs required specific targeted prompting.
